import { getAccessToken } from "/src/api/authSession.js";
import { PrepCenterApiError } from "/src/features/teacher-prep-center/api/prepCenterApi.ts";
export const LESSON_PLAN_API_BASE = "/api/teacher-v3/artifacts/lesson-plans";
function authHeader() {
  const token = getAccessToken();
  return token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {};
}
function newIdempotencyKey() {
  return crypto?.randomUUID?.() ?? `pc-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
}
async function planRequest(path, init) {
  let res;
  try {
    res = await fetch(`${LESSON_PLAN_API_BASE}${path}`, {
      ...init,
      headers: {
        Accept: "application/json",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        ...authHeader(),
        ...init.headers || {}
      }
    });
  } catch (e) {
    if (e?.name === "AbortError") throw e;
    throw new PrepCenterApiError({ kind: "network", status: null, code: null, detail: e?.message });
  }
  let body = null;
  try {
    body = await res.json();
  } catch {
    body = null;
  }
  if (!res.ok || !body || typeof body.code === "number" && body.code !== 0) {
    const status = res.status;
    let kind = "error";
    if (status === 401) kind = "unauthenticated";
    else if (status === 403) kind = "forbidden";
    else if (status === 409) kind = "conflict";
    else if (status === 404) kind = "not_found";
    else if (status === 429) kind = "rate_limited";
    throw new PrepCenterApiError({
      kind,
      status,
      code: typeof body?.code === "number" ? body.code : null,
      detail: body?.message || body?.detail || `lesson-plan api error: ${status}`,
      requestId: body?.request_id ?? res.headers.get("x-request-id") ?? null,
      data: body?.data && typeof body.data === "object" ? body.data : null,
      errorKey: typeof body?.error_key === "string" ? body.error_key : null
    });
  }
  return body.data ?? body;
}
export function fetchLessonPlanSpec(specId, signal) {
  return planRequest(`/${encodeURIComponent(specId)}`, { method: "GET", signal });
}
export function createLessonPlanPatch(specId, payload, signal) {
  return planRequest(`/${encodeURIComponent(specId)}/patches`, {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({ idempotency_key: newIdempotencyKey(), source: "human", ...payload }),
    signal
  });
}
export function applyLessonPlanPatch(specId, patchId, expectedRevision, signal) {
  return planRequest(
    `/${encodeURIComponent(specId)}/patches/${encodeURIComponent(patchId)}/apply`,
    { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ expected_revision: expectedRevision }), signal }
  );
}
export function regenLessonPlanBlock(specId, payload, signal) {
  return planRequest(`/${encodeURIComponent(specId)}/regen`, {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    signal
  });
}
